title: LPG cylinder shortage live: Fuel supplies stable, consumers urged to move from LPG to PNG, says govt
desc: LPG crisis live updates: The government has said the LPG supply situation remains a concern and has urged consumers to use cooking gas judiciously, even as steps are being taken to expand piped natural gas infrastructure to reduce dependence on LPG. In a nationwide crackdown, officials said over 12,000 raids have been carried out and more than 15,000 LPG cylinders seized to curb hoarding and black marketing under the Essential Commodities Act. Authorities are also pushing commercial users in urban areas to shift to PNG, with easier connection processes and incentives being offered. Online LPG bookings have risen to around 94%, while commercial supplies have started resuming in several states with government support. Even as fresh shipments like Shivalik and Nanda Devi have reached India, the impact of earlier disruptions continues to be felt across sectors. Follow this live blog for the latest updates on LPG supply, government measures and the situation across cities and industries in India.
